served_mismatch: The effect and confidence interval match. However, the served analysis_set is intention-to-treat, whereas the registry explicitly defines an FAS with exclusions for inadvertently randomized, unqualified patients who received no investigational drug; unrestricted ITT is not established.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria specify CHF with LVEF ≤35%; the registry additionally specifies a minimum age of 20 years.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Outpatients with a diagnosis of CHF NYHA class II-IV and reduced ejection fraction: * LVEF ≤ 35% at Visit 1

notes: Registry evidence used. Randomized regimens were LCZ696 100 mg twice daily, titrated to 200 mg twice daily at week 4 if tolerated, versus enalapril 5 mg twice daily, titrated to 10 mg twice daily at week 4 if tolerated. Events on or after the end-of-study declaration were excluded from efficacy analysis. The registry lists three HR analyses without explicit endpoint labels on those lines; analysis 0 follows the primary-composite measurement, before the component analyses.
